newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder Aug newspaper revs up 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder Aug newspaper revs up 9.9 pct.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said on Monday that total newspaper revenue was $179.5 million in August, up 9.9 percent from a year ago.
Year-to-date total newspaper revenue was $1.56 billion, up 7.1 percent from the same period a year ago.
Total advertising lineage in August rose 16.7 percent to 2.7 million inches and was up 13.0 percent to $22.7 million year-to-date.
Pro forma newspaper revenue was up 2.4 percent in August and 4.0 percent year-to-date.

Pro forma comparisons assume that Contra Costa Newspapers were a part of Knight-Ridder since the beginning of last year and exclude Detroit newspapers, due to a 13-month strike there, the company said.
